components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary, #0d5c49); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-strong, #084334); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0d5c49); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c4ba); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #12211d); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-soft, #f6f8f4); border-color: var(--primary, #0d5c49); color: var(--primary, #0d5c49); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0d5c49); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; soft seal-red ground, never a solid red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid #efc3bd; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--danger-soft, #fbe7e4); color: #8f2b22; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #f6d8d4; color: #7a221a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0d5c49); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action such as cancel or refresh.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #46564f); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--primary-soft, #dcefe6); color: var(--primary, #0d5c49); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0d5c49); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field with an evergreen focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--ink-soft, #46564f); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c4ba); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #12211d); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #0d5c49); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(13, 92, 73, 0.14); } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--surface-soft, #f6f8f4); color: var(--muted, #64736c); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat white container separated by a hairline border.
components.html:
Perangkat

Kelola token dan penugasan pemilih.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill label for election state; open, paused, or closed.
components.html: Dibuka Ditunda Ditutup
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d8ded6); border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-open { background: var(--primary-soft, #dcefe6); border-color: #b9dece; color: var(--primary, #0d5c49); } .ds-badge-paused { background: var(--accent-soft, #fdf1cf); border-color: #ecd28d; color: #6e4a00; } .ds-badge-closed { background: #eef0ed; color: #55635c; }

components.css: .ds-ballot { position: relative; overflow: visible; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--ink, #12211d); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(18, 33, 29, 0.12); color: #f7faf6; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-ballot-stub { display: block; padding: 15px 28px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); color: var(--accent, #f0b429); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-ballot-body { padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 34px); } .ds-ballot-body h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif); font-size: 1.72rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-ballot-body p { margin: 0; color: rgba(247, 250, 246, 0.72); font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.7; }

narrative.overview: This is a civic instrument, not a campaign poster. The interface borrows the calm of an official polling desk: soft paper-green ground, white forms, a dense evergreen used for authority, and a single amber mark that reads like a stamp or a highlighter. Every surface is quiet enough that the voter's next action is unmistakable, and official enough that the result feels legitimate. The world is deliberately flat and border-led. Thin lines, generous white space, and a restrained green palette carry structure; depth appears only where a physical artifact is implied, most clearly the dark ballot card with its torn stub and hard offset shadow. Typography does the persuasion: Bricolage Grotesque gives headlines a slightly condensed, notice-board confidence, while Plus Jakarta Sans keeps instructions plain and Indonesian copy readable at kiosk distance.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-green ground with white forms and evergreen authority.
Amber used sparingly as a stamp, marker, or live-status signal.
Flat, border-defined surfaces; a single hard offset shadow for the ballot artifact.
Display type with tight, negative tracking; body type plain and legible.
Rounded but restrained geometry: 9-20px radii, pill-shaped status only.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is a mark, not a theme. Keep it under roughly 10% of any screen; it should feel like a stamp on paper, never a second brand color.

rules.name: The Green Means Action Rule
rules.body: Evergreen is reserved for things the voter or admin should act on, trust, or read as live. Do not use it for decorative fills or inactive states.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Only Bricolage may carry negative tracking and large scale. Body and label text stay in Plus Jakarta Sans with normal tracking so the two voices never compete.

rules.name: The Kiosk Distance Rule
rules.body: Voter-facing headlines must remain legible at arm's length on a shared monitor; never reduce the display step on the device flow to fit more copy.

rules.name: The Paper-Not-Plastic Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on ordinary panels, cards, tables, or buttons. If a surface needs separation, use a hairline border or a tonal step, not a shadow.

dos: Do use evergreen for the single primary action per view and let everything else recede.
Do use a 1px hairline or a soft-field step to separate surfaces instead of a shadow.
Do keep amber to stamps, live-status dots, stub labels, and the paused badge.
Do keep controls at 44px minimum height with clear 2px evergreen focus outlines.
Do use Bricolage only for display, headline, and title roles, with negative tracking.
Do preserve the ballot card's notches, dashed tear line, and offset shadow together; they are one artifact.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or a gradient as brand expression; the only gradient is the results progress bar.
Don't put shadows on ordinary panels, cards, tables, or buttons.
Don't use solid red fills for destructive actions; use the soft danger ground.
Don't make pill shapes into buttons or navigation controls.
Don't set Indonesian copy in uppercase or all-caps tracking; sentence case is the voice.
Don't reduce the device-flow display type below its clamp minimum to fit more content.
